channel.title: US Housing Lottery HOT
channel.description: Public lotteries from NYC Housing Connect, San Francisco DAHLIA, Los Angeles Access Housing LA, San Jose Housing Portal and Boston Metrolist: sorted by deadline, showing only our own paraphrased titles and one-line summaries, city, unit count, deadline and the official application link — no republished originals.

item.title: Brooklyn lottery closes Nov 20: only 3 affordable rentals
item.description: Closing Nov 20, but only 3 homes in Brooklyn, so treat this one as a long shot and put your main effort into the larger openings closing the same week.
item.source: NYC Open Data: Housing Connect Lotteries

item.title: New York lottery closes Nov 20: 18 affordable rentals, all low income
item.description: Closing Nov 20: 18 affordable rentals in New York City, all low income, with studios through two-bedrooms; a balanced mix for singles and small families.
item.source: NYC Open Data: Housing Connect Lotteries

item.title: Queens lottery closes Nov 20: 4 two-bedroom affordable rentals
item.description: Closing Nov 20 in Queens: just 4 two-bedroom homes, all low income; small opening, so apply if it fits and do not count on it alone.
item.source: NYC Open Data: Housing Connect Lotteries

item.title: Manhattan lottery closes Nov 20: 20 affordable rentals for moderate incomes
item.description: Closing Nov 20 in Manhattan: 20 rentals for moderate incomes, with one-, two- and three-bedrooms; Manhattan openings are rare, so moderate-income households should not let this one pass.
item.source: NYC Open Data: Housing Connect Lotteries

item.title: Bronx lottery closes Nov 20: only 3 two-bedroom affordable rentals
item.description: Closing Nov 20 in the Bronx: only 3 two-bedroom homes, all low income; a small opening best treated as an extra entry alongside bigger lotteries.
item.source: NYC Open Data: Housing Connect Lotteries

item.title: Bronx lottery closes Nov 23: 6 affordable rentals
item.description: Closing Nov 23 in the Bronx: 6 low-income rentals with a studio, one- and two-bedrooms; no rush today, but set a reminder, since the days pass quickly.
item.source: NYC Open Data: Housing Connect Lotteries

item.title: Brooklyn mega lottery: 217 affordable rentals, closing Nov 25
item.description: The biggest opening this week: 217 Brooklyn rentals, closing Nov 25, with homes for extremely low, very low and low incomes and every bedroom size; if you can only apply to one lottery, make it this one.
item.source: NYC Open Data: Housing Connect Lotteries

item.title: Bronx lottery open until December 18: 6 affordable rentals
item.description: The longest runway on the board: a Bronx lottery open until December 18, with 6 low-income one- and two-bedrooms; no urgency this week, so check the income bands carefully and apply when ready.
item.source: NYC Open Data: Housing Connect Lotteries

item.title: San Francisco lottery closes Nov 20: 62 brand-new affordable rentals
item.description: Closing Nov 20: this 62-home new rental opening is the biggest San Francisco lottery open right now. Check the income band first and apply before the deadline-night rush.

item.title: San Francisco waitlist closes December 2: only 2 affordable rentals
item.description: Just 2 homes, and this one is a waitlist rather than a lottery, so expect a long queue — only join if the income band fits.

item.title: San Francisco waitlist closes December 4: 37 affordable rentals
item.description: 37 homes on a waitlist closing December 4. A waitlist rewards queue position, not luck, so register early if the income band fits.

item.title: San Francisco lottery closes December 9: 21 brand-new affordable rentals
item.description: 21 brand-new rentals in a standard lottery closing December 9. A good fit for households hoping for a new building — check the income band first.

item.title: One senior rental left in San Jose: first-come deadline December 1
item.description: Just 1 senior home left, first-come not a lottery, closing December 1. If the household qualifies, apply now — there is nothing to wait for.

item.title: Six senior rentals open in San Jose: first-come deadline December 13
item.description: 6 senior homes, first-come, closing December 13 — generous for a senior project. Good for older households looking near downtown.

item.title: Two affordable rentals open in San Jose: first-come deadline January 2
item.description: Just 2 homes, first-come, closing January 2. The window is comfortable, but with only 2 homes, have the paperwork ready.

item.title: Six family rentals open in San Jose: first-come deadline February 1
item.description: 6 family homes, first-come, closing February 1 — the longest window this round, good for households that need time to gather income documents.

item.title: Los Angeles first-come deadline December 1: only 1 affordable rental left
item.description: Just 1 home left, first-come not a lottery, and the window closes December 1. If the income band fits, apply now — there is nothing to wait for.

item.title: Los Angeles first-come deadline December 1: 4 affordable rentals
item.description: 4 homes, first-come not a lottery, closing December 1. First-come rewards speed, so apply early if the income band fits.

item.title: Los Angeles lottery closes December 10: 76 affordable rentals
item.description: A 76-home lottery closing December 10, one of the biggest Los Angeles openings this round. Lotteries do not reward speed, so check the income band and apply in good time.

item.title: Los Angeles lottery closes December 10: 69 affordable rentals
item.description: A 69-home lottery closing December 10, the same day as another big Los Angeles opening. Households in the income band can apply to both.
